purpose: Define how the private patient record system connects clinical notes, treatments, formulas, medications, outcomes, and future billing documentation.
privacy_rule: Use de-identified patient codes only. Do not store full names, full dates of birth, phone numbers, addresses, insurance IDs, or other direct identifiers in this local study app.

modules.description: Create patient code, case title, chief complaint, western conditions, TCM disease categories, patterns, safety flags, and treatment goals.
Document subjective, objective, assessment, plan, points used, technique, formula/herbs, western medications, outcomes, and follow-up.
Track visit number, treatment frequency, retention time, symptom scores, fertility cycle phase, cycle day, functional changes, and response over time.
Keep future CPT/ICD-10 training in mind by preserving diagnosis, medical necessity, treatment performed, patient response, and plan.

next_modeling_tasks: Add visit-level outcome scale templates for pain, sleep, digestion, mood, menstrual cycle, and fertility treatment.
Add case-type templates for infertility, pain, stress/anxiety, digestive disorders, dermatology, and sleep.
Connect SOAP point names to acupoint records by code.
Connect formula/herb text to formula and herb records.
Add a billing checklist panel after the SOAP note is saved.
